description:
DECISION GATE for the dev-loop v2 program (single trunk behind merge queue, six always-reporting unit checks, T0-T4 tiers, build-once hashed artifacts, retirement of the old CI/post-merge/release-branch machinery). Nothing in phases 2+ starts until the owner approves these decisions in writing.

D1 Trunk stays `develop` (no rename to main in this program).
D2 Publication control plane stays; this program only wires it to the new CI and retires lane workflows and the docs.yml legacy Pages fallback. Full replacement is a separate program with entry criteria: pinned source+corpus SHAs, retained artifact identity, post-deploy route+digest probes, durable receipt, exact-artifact rollback with last-known-good check, one serialized production writer with generation check, route-manifest support in scripts/assemble_public_site.py, rollback tested with github-pages reviewers enabled.
D3 Results corpus homes unchanged (results-data/ + published-results branch).
D4 Soundness hold moves to CODEOWNERS + require_code_owner_review (already on in ruleset develop-squash-only); agents may enqueue directly for non-owned paths.
D5 Agent tooling kept (worktree targets, agent-identity-check, agent-write-preflight, check_agent_trailers, todo-state); agent PR-loop tooling (pr-landing, pr-followups, soundness drain, local-validation) retires.
D6 Codecov kept, informational, uploaded from T2; CODECOV_TOKEN stays.
D7 Ruleset drift detection kept: scripts/ruleset_drift_check.py runs inside ci.yml `tooling` (required) and release.yml; RULESET_DRIFT_TOKEN stays.
